dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a slight concave spline curvature from the posterior base to the apex.

dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree angular steepness relative to the dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is roughly 1.3 times the maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle visible at the transition point between the melon and the upper mandible.
